method.cpu_gpu_runtime: Installed TFLite C API 2.8.4; CPU 2 threads; GPU delegate OpenCL partition, residual CPU ops possible
method.htp_runtime: QAIRT/QNN 2.51.40.260930; libQnnHtp.so only; perf_profile default; profiling client; discard first warmup executions
method.scope: TFLite InterpreterInvoke and QNN NETRUN ROOT EXECUTE; excludes model loading/compile, input preprocessing, host postprocess/NMS, rendering and ADB. TFLite SSD includes built-in detection postprocess/NMS; QNN SSD graph excludes host NMS. Converted/quantized artifacts differ; pipeline latency ratios, not pure hardware speedups or FPS.
method.order: Rotate CPU/GPU/HTP order each session; no global governors/services/settings changed
method.placement_evidence: Detailed HTP functional profiles: htp251/evidence/20261101T195905Z-ffc9e, matching current DLC hashes. Timing uses client profiling to avoid detailed per-op overhead.
method.reference_scope: Same prepared PNG per task, semantic checks against original TFLite CPU; selected images, not dataset accuracy
